title: Two questions about the user interface
author: vndnua
body_snippet: 1. When I move (using the mouse or keyboard) an existing connection in the tree, nothing visually happens. The element is actually being moved; it’s just that the tree isn’t being redrawn. If I create a new connection or delete an existing one, the connection tree is updated immediately and the changes are visible. 2.
